summary: Request SYN-04 from Arjun Mehta (Engineering, IC5) is for MetricLoop Extra Seats (30 users, annual cost 25000.01 USD, Analytics / BI, internal_documents access, no integrations). MetricLoop is an already-approved vendor (procurement, security and legal terms all Approved; security review 2026-05-10; risk level low) and the product is an expansion of existing catalog software SW006 (Approved, 55 licensed seats, company-wide scope). Engineering has 26000 USD available against the 25000.01 USD cost and the request is within budget. evaluate_policy returned no risk flags, no missing information and no data classes, with required approvals Department Head, Finance, CFO and Procurement and baseline label 'Proceed with standard approvals'. No instruction-like text was found in the request fields and no tool failures or conflicting data were observed.
concerns: The request is a seat expansion of existing approved MetricLoop software (SW006, 55 licensed seats, company-wide scope, covers_requester_department true); no data shows whether the current 55 seats are fully used or why existing company-wide licensing is insufficient for the engineering productivity team.

get_vendor_risk reports processes_personal_data true for MetricLoop (stores_data_outside_region false); the request only declares internal_documents access, so the personal data handling is a vendor-level fact that was not tied to this request by any tool.
Engineering available budget is 26000 USD against an annual cost of 25000.01 USD, so the request fits within budget but consumes nearly all remaining headroom.

overlap_assessment.reason: find_existing_software matched MetricLoop (SW006, Approved, 55 licensed seats, Company-wide) on same_vendor, same_product and same_category, so this is an extension of the existing tool rather than a different vendor's overlapping tool. The stated need is additional dashboard seats for the engineering productivity team, which is a seat-capacity gap; seat utilisation of the existing 55 seats could not be verified from the tool results.
